The '''Imperial Vehicle Corps''' was a ground vehicle-based [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Corps/Legends|corps]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. They were part of the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]].<ref name="Rulebook" />
